policy.ownership: Exclude the live structure-catalog candidates, collection members, and the complete Important Landmarks list reserved for the other device.
policy.quality: Recognizable medium-fi exterior. Complete construction,focused visual/runtime review,placement,catalog and story sync in one cycle. Approximate unseen non-defining detail; do not launch repeated reference/terrain research campaigns.
policy.selection: Round robin by region across independently named unmodeled buildings. Prefer varied countries and building categories. Prior fixed targets, registered catalog matches and other-device reservations excluded. Published Qualla public-domain candidates take priority.
